name: Physics puzzle
core_loop: Read the room and find the locked door
Grab a crate and work out where its weight is needed
Carry or throw it onto the pressure plate
Walk through the opened door into the next room

questions.question: What ends the game once the rooms are solved?
How much should the game hint at the solution?
How many rooms should the first build hold?

acceptance.promise: A crate inside reach can be grabbed, carried without clipping, and thrown.
setup: Place one crate at grab_range from the player
Place a second crate beyond grab_range
probes: Aim at the near crate and grab, then read the held body
Walk one metre and sample the crate transform each frame
Aim at the far crate and grab, then read the held body
Throw the held crate and record its landing point
evidence: The near crate becomes the held body and the far crate does not
The carried crate never intersects the level collider
The thrown crate leaves with throw_force and comes to rest

acceptance.promise: A plate holds its door open only while enough mass rests on it.
setup: Load one room with a plate, a door and a crate heavier than required_mass
probes: Place the crate on the plate and read the door state
Lift the crate off the plate and read the door state
Solve every room and read the run result
evidence: The door opens while the crate rests on the plate
The door closes when the plate is cleared
The run result is a win once every room reports solved
